import cadquery as cq

# Plate X 0-40, Y 0-20, Z 0-4
plate = cq.Solid.makeBox(40, 20, 4, cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))

# Round boss Ø10 on top at (10,10), Z 4-14
boss = cq.Solid.makeCylinder(5, 10, cq.Vector(10, 10, 4), cq.Vector(0, 0, 1))

base = plate.fuse(boss)

# 3 mm hole through boss and plate at (10,10)
hole = cq.Solid.makeCylinder(1.5, 16, cq.Vector(10, 10, -1), cq.Vector(0, 0, 1))

# Slot obround 16 long (Y) x 6 wide (X), centred at (28,10), through plate
# Build as central box + two end cylinders extruded in Z
slot_box = cq.Solid.makeBox(6, 10, 6, cq.Vector(25, 5, -1))  # 28±3, 10±5
cyl_a = cq.Solid.makeCylinder(3, 6, cq.Vector(28, 15, -1), cq.Vector(0, 0, 1))
cyl_b = cq.Solid.makeCylinder(3, 6, cq.Vector(28, 5, -1), cq.Vector(0, 0, 1))
slot = slot_box.fuse(cyl_a).fuse(cyl_b)

result = base.cut(hole).cut(slot)
